gaps.desktop: The loser's blue section headings ('Slides and notes', 'Preparation') and their more-dots are a dull slate blue (about #3a5f95, reads grey-blue next to black body text), and the title is semibold. The winner uses a saturated blue (about #1f63c8) for headings and dots, and a bold title about 20% heavier, so the hierarchy reads straight away. Fix: move the heading colour to the vivid accent blue and set the title to bold.
gaps.phone: The loser has no filter pill row at all. Between the notes (ending at y~205) and the first 'Things to buy' heading (y~298) there is about 90px of dead white space. The winner puts an All / Active / Completed pill row at y~253 (selected pill about 28px tall, grey #b5b5b8 fill, white semibold text) and brings the heading up to y~330, which keeps the rhythm tight. Fix: render the filter pills under the notes and close the gap.

why: Phone: the loser drops the filter pills and leaves a hole. Desktop: the winner's saturated heading blue and bold title give clearer hierarchy on otherwise identical rows.
